description: Hosted servers: get a signed upload URL for ONE file you then upload with therapyportal_upload_document. Sends nothing to the practice. PUT the file’s bytes to uploadUrl with the returned Content-Type (the returned curl does exactly that; replace its <path to …> placeholder), then call therapyportal_upload_document with blob_key. The URL expires at expiresAt. Same file rules as the upload: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC or DOCX, up to 25 MB, a bare filename; .doc is refused.

filename.description: The name the practice will see — a bare name with its extension, e.g. "scan.pdf".

mime_type.description: Optional; must agree with the extension. Default: from the extension.

name: therapyportal_upload_slot
